name: CI Docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - agents-docs/**
      - packages/agents-core/src/**
      - agents-cli/src/**
      - agents-api/__snapshots__/openapi.json
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - agents-docs/**
      - packages/agents-core/src/**
      - agents-cli/src/**
      - agents-api/__snapshots__/openapi.json
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build, lint, and typecheck agents-docs
        run: |
          npm run turbo -- run build lint typecheck --filter=@inkeep/agents-docs
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=8192
